info.prompt: A high-resolution digital painting of a cyber-gothic battle royale interface, with skeletal gold filigree framing neon-drenched UI panels, where outer tiles burn away in pulsing orange-red waves every 30 seconds, leaving only a glowing 3-tile core. The background is void black with synaptic cyan/magenta neural lattice connections, while rogue-class dice hover beside amber-gold ability pips, their geometry jagged like shattered stained glass. Cinematic camera angles sweep past crystalline dice textures, terminal-style hack logs scrolling at the bottom.
